executive_summary: Maven build failed with 22 compilation errors. The primary issue is that the Column class is incorrectly being used as an annotation instead of a JPA entity annotation (@Column). Additionally, there are method signature mismatches and missing setter methods in entity classes.

errors.message: incompatible types: Column cannot be converted to java.lang.annotation.Annotation (19 occurrences across Column.java, Task.java, User.java)
errors.root_cause: The custom Column class is being used as an annotation (@Column) in entity classes, but it's not defined as an annotation type. The code should use javax.persistence.Column or jakarta.persistence.Column annotation instead of the custom Column entity class.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace all @Column annotations with @jakarta.persistence.Column (or @javax.persistence.Column for older Spring Boot versions). Rename the custom Column entity class to avoid naming conflicts, e.g., rename it to ColumnEntity or BoardColumn.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types; required: Long,Pageable found: Long,int,int,String
errors.root_cause: The TaskController is calling getUserTasks with 4 parameters (Long userId, int page, int size, String sort) but the TaskService interface expects only 2 parameters (Long userId, Pageable pageable). The controller needs to construct a Pageable object from the pagination parameters.
errors.fix_recommendation: In TaskController.java line 46, create a Pageable object using PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(sort)) and pass it to getUserTasks method. Import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest and org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method setLastUpdated(LocalDateTime) (2 occurrences at lines 41 and 56)
errors.root_cause: The Column entity class is missing the setLastUpdated() setter method. The InMemoryColumnDataStore is trying to call this method to update the lastUpdated timestamp, but it doesn't exist in the Column class.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add the setLastUpdated(LocalDateTime lastUpdated) setter method to the Column entity class. Ensure the Column class has a private LocalDateTime lastUpdated field with proper getter and setter methods.
